name: The Girl At The Shrine
source:
A short kinetic novel about a man who receives guidance from a mysterious girl during a difficult time.

Framed for a crime you didn't commit and forced out of your job, you find yourself at your lowest point. A mysterious girl at the shrine of Inari Okami seems to have all of the answers though. Her wit, wisdom and mischief may be just what you need to get through this crisis. Will following her unusual advice help you avert disaster and find your purpose?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5496650/]Steam[/url]]
